paragraphs: Roblox is an immersive gaming and creation platform (the "Roblox Platform" or "Platform") that offers people millions of ways to be together, inviting its community to explore, create, and share endless unique experiences. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together– in a world that's safe, civil, and optimistic. To achieve this vision, we are building an innovative company that, together with the Roblox community, has the ability to strengthen our social fabric and support economic growth for people around the world.

Our Platform consists of the Roblox Client, the Roblox Studio, and the Roblox Cloud. Roblox Client is the application that allows users to seamlessly explore immersive experiences. Roblox Studio is the free toolset that allows creators to build, publish, and operate immersive experiences and other content accessed with the Roblox Client. Roblox Cloud includes the services and infrastructure that power our Platform.

Our mission is to connect a billion users with optimism and civility. We are constantly improving the ways in which our Platform supports shared experiences, ranging from how these experiences are built by an engaged community of creators to how they are enjoyed and safely accessed by users across the globe. We also believe there is a strong potential to capture a greater percentage of the global gaming market within the Roblox ecosystem. Our goal is to make it as easy as possible for creators to build better and safer experiences, including games, and ultimately reach more users. We continue to invest in creating tools for our creators designed to promote key experience genres and deepen engagement on our Platform.
Growth at Roblox has been driven primarily by a significant investment in technology and two mutually reinforcing network effects: content and connections.

First, user-generated content built by our community of creators powers our Platform. As creators build increasingly high-quality and diverse content, more users are attracted to our Platform. With more users on our Platform, greater engagement and monetization opportunities exist, which in turn, makes Roblox more attractive to creators, incentivizing them to design increasingly engaging content and encouraging new creators to start building on our Platform.

Second, our Platform encourages connections. When users join, they typically interact with friends, which inspires them to invite more friends, who in turn, invite their friends, driving organic growth. The more friends that each of our users have interacting on the Platform, the more valuable and engaging the Platform becomes. This drives more users to our Platform through word of mouth from their existing friends on the Platform.

Roblox is powered by content from our community of creators who build immersive and engaging experiences on Roblox, as well as the vast majority of the items for customizing avatars. This content attracts our users to immerse themselves in the millions of experiences found on the Platform. Many of our users may also eventually become creators.

In the year ended December 31, 2025, 127 million average DAUs across over 180 countries enjoyed experiences on Roblox across mobile, desktop, and console platforms, of which on average, approximately 1.8 million were daily unique paying users. Our users are diversified across multiple dimensions, including age, geography, platform, and gender. Each day, users express themselves through their avatars, explore different worlds, and engage with others in the Roblox community. During the year ended December 31, 2025, users spent 123.9 billion hours engaged on our Platform, or an average of 2.7 hours per DAU each day. Over the same period, our users explored an average of over 24 different experiences on our Platform per month.

(1)Represents the average during the year ended December 31, 2025. Refer to "Special Note Regarding Operating Metrics" for details on operating metrics used. Percentages presented are calculated from the underlying numbers in thousands and may not add to their respective totals due to rounding.

We believe that everyone can become a creator. We offer creators the ability to build engaging, immersive experiences, and avatar related items in our Marketplace and custom models, plugins, audio, fonts, images, meshes, and video in our Creator Store that they can easily share with the Roblox community. Our creators enable us to offer a wide variety of content on our Platform and cost-effectively crowd-source the experiences available on our Platform, Marketplace items, and creator tool ecosystem. In the year ended December 31, 2025, we had millions of creators across more than 170 countries building on our Platform. Our creator community includes individuals with a wide spectrum of professional capabilities and team sizes, ranging from young students and independent hobbyists, all the way to full-time studios.

We measure the health and success of our creator community based on our economy and user engagement. As our Platform has scaled, our monetizing creators have enjoyed meaningful growth over time, reflecting the increasing popularity and opportunities for monetization of our Platform and driving a growing incentive for our creators to continue building high-quality content.

We offer our creator community several models to help support their goals. Specifically, creators can accumulate Robux (which we refer to as "earned Robux"), or, in some circumstances, be paid directly in money (referred to herein as "fiat currency", to differentiate from Robux, which is an in-game currency), through the following methods:
1.Monetizing a developed experience: Creators can accumulate earned Robux through:

a.In-experience purchases, which consist of microtransactions generated from the sale of in-experience virtual items, subscription-based offerings (including access to private servers), access to certain experiences (referred to as paid access), and/or passes granting special in-experience privileges.

headings: We have a history of net losses and we may not be able to achieve or maintain profitability in the future.

We have experienced rapid growth at times, in part due to the virality of certain experiences on our Platform, and our growth rates may not be indicative of our future growth or the growth of our market.
We are subject to numerous legal proceedings that are costly and time-consuming to defend and could harm our business, financial condition, or results of operations.
If we fail to retain users or add new users, or if our users decrease their level of engagement with our Platform, our revenue, bookings, and operating results will be harmed.
We depend on our creators to create digital content that our users find compelling, and if we fail to properly incentivize our creators to develop and monetize content, our business will suffer.
If we are unable to further monetize our Platform and user base, our business will suffer.
The loss of one or more of our key personnel, or our failure to attract and retain other highly qualified personnel in the future, could harm our business.
paragraphs: A description of the risks and uncertainties associated with our business is set forth below. You should carefully consider the risks described below, as well as the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our consolidated financial statements and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." The occurrence of any of the events or developments described below could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and growth prospects. In such an event, the market price of our Class A common stock could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently believe are not material may also impair our business, financial condition, results of operations, and growth prospects.
Below is a summary of the principal factors that make an investment in our Class A common stock speculative or risky:
•We have a history of net losses and we may not be able to achieve or maintain profitability in the future.

•Our business is affected by seasonal demands, and our financial condition and results of operations will fluctuate from quarter to quarter, which makes our financial results difficult to predict and may not fully reflect our underlying performance.

•We are subject to laws and regulations worldwide that are constantly evolving, which could increase our costs or adversely affect our business, including preventing our ability to operate our Platform in certain jurisdictions.

•We have experienced rapid growth at times, in part due to the virality of certain experiences on our Platform, and our growth rates may not be indicative of our future growth or the growth of our market.

This discussion and analysis and other parts of this Annual Report on Form 10-K contain forward-looking statements, such as those relating to our plans, objectives, expectations, intentions, and beliefs, that involve risks, uncertainties, and assumptions. Our actual results could differ materially from these forward-looking statements as a result of many factors, including those discussed in the section titled "Risk Factors," "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements," and "Special Note Regarding Operating Metrics" included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for any periods in the future. Unless the context otherwise requires, all references in this report to "Roblox," the "Company," "we," "our," "us," or similar terms refer to Roblox Corporation and its subsidiaries.

This section of our Annual Report on Form 10-K discusses our financial condition as of and results of operations for the fiscal years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, as well as year-to-year comparisons between fiscal years 2025 and 2024. A discussion of our financial condition as of and results of operations for the fiscal year ended 2023 and year-to-year comparisons between fiscal years 2024 and 2023 that is not included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K can be found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024.

People from around the world come to Roblox every day to connect. Together they create, play, work, learn, and connect with each other in experiences built by our global community of creators. Our Platform is powered by user-generated content and draws inspiration from gaming, entertainment, social media, and even toys.

Our immersive gaming and creation Platform consists of the Roblox Client, the Roblox Studio, and the Roblox Cloud (collectively, the "Roblox Platform" or the "Platform"). Roblox Client is the free application that allows users to explore immersive experiences. Roblox Studio is the free toolset that allows creators to build, publish, and operate immersive experiences and other content accessed with the Roblox Client. Roblox Cloud includes the services and infrastructure that power our Platform. We are continually innovating our Platform by investing in high fidelity avatars, more realistic experiences, artificial intelligence ("AI") tools, and other connection features.

Our mission is to connect a billion users with optimism and civility. We are constantly improving the ways in which our Platform supports shared experiences, ranging from how these experiences are built by an engaged community of creators to how they are enjoyed and safely accessed by users across the globe. We also believe there is a strong potential to capture a greater percentage of the global gaming market within the Roblox ecosystem. Our goal is to make it as easy as possible for creators to build better and safer experiences, including games, and ultimately reach more users. We continue to invest in creating tools for our creators designed to promote key experience genres and deepen engagement on our Platform.

Consistent with our free to use business model, a small portion of our users have historically been payers. For example, in the year ended December 31, 2025, of our 127 million average Daily Active Users ("DAUs"), only approximately 1.8 million represented our average daily unique paying users. Similarly, in the year ended December 31, 2025, our average daily bookings per DAU was $0.15, whereas our average daily bookings per daily unique paying user was $10.36. We believe that maintaining and growing our overall number of users, including the number of users who may not purchase and spend Robux, is important to the success of our business. As a result, we believe that the number of users who choose to purchase and spend Robux will continue to constitute a small portion of our overall users.

We are constantly innovating our safety tools and launching new safeguards to promote a safe and enjoyable environment for our users. As our safety teams continue to innovate and use advancements in technology to help users feel safe on our Platform, we expect to continue to implement Platform policy, product, technology, and other changes, including in anticipation of and in response to regulatory requirements and evolving guidance from leading global organizations focused on child and internet safety in the U.S. and abroad. We are currently developing, testing, and implementing age-check systems designed to check a user's age prior to accessing chat on our Platform. Our safety changes have impacted and in the future may continue to impact engagement, retention, revenue, and bookings.

Our primary areas of investment have been, and we expect will continue to be, our creator community, and the people, technology, and infrastructure, including our trust and safety systems, required to keep improving the Roblox Platform while maintaining and building a safe and civil online community. These areas of focus are how we drive the business, and along with payment processing fees, represent our primary operating costs.

We believe our performance is dependent upon many factors, including the key metrics described below that we track and review to measure our performance, identify trends, formulate financial projections, and make strategic decisions.

We manage our business by tracking several operating metrics, including those outlined below. As a management team, we believe each of these operating metrics provides useful information to investors and others. For complete definitions and limitations of these metrics, refer to the section titled "Special Note Regarding Operating Metrics" of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

We define a DAU as a user who has logged in and visited Roblox through our website or application on a unique registered account on a given calendar day. If a registered, logged in user visits Roblox more than once within a 24-hour period that spans two calendar days, that user is counted as a DAU only for the first calendar day. We track DAUs as an indicator of the size of the audience engaged on our Platform. We believe that the long-term growth in DAUs reflects the increasing value of our Platform.

We define hours engaged as the time spent by our users on the Platform. We calculate total hours engaged as the aggregate of user session lengths in a given period. We estimate this length of time using internal company systems that track user activity on our Platform as discrete events, and aggregate these discrete activities into a user session. A given user session on our Platform may include, among other things, time spent in experiences, in Roblox Studio, in Platform features such as chat and avatar personalization, in the Creator Store, and some amount of non-active time due to limits within the tracking systems and our estimation methodology. We believe that the long-term growth in hours engaged reflects the increasing value of our Platform.

Bookings is a non-GAAP financial measure and represents the sales activity in a given period without giving effect to certain non-cash adjustments. Bookings is presented for supplemental informational purposes only and should not be considered in isolation from, or as a substitute for, financial information presented in accordance with GAAP. Refer to the section "Non-GAAP Financial Measures" below for further discussion on this measure, including its limitations.

paragraphs: Roblox 是一個沉浸式遊戲與創作平台（"Roblox 平台" 或 "平台"），提供人們數百萬種方式來互動，邀請其社羣探索、創作並分享無限的獨特體驗。我們的願景是重新想像人們相聚的方式–在一個安全、文明且樂觀的世界上。為實現此願景，我們正在建立一個創新公司，與 Roblox 社羣合作，有能力強化我們的社會結構並支持全球人們的經濟成長。
我們的平台包含 Roblox 客戶端、Roblox 編輯器與 Roblox 雲端。Roblox 客戶端是讓使用者無縫探索沉浸式體驗的應用程式。Roblox 編輯器是讓創作者建立、發佈並運作沉浸式體驗及其他可透過 Roblox 客戶端存取的內容的免費工具組。Roblox 雲端包含支撐我們平台的服務與基礎設施。
我們的使命是將十億用戶與樂觀與文明連結。我們持續改善平台支持共創體驗的方式，從這些體驗由積極參與的創作者社羣所建立，到這些體驗如何被全球用戶享受並安全存取。我們也相信在 Roblox 生態系統中，有強大的潛力來佔據更大比例的全球遊戲市場。我們的目標是讓創作者盡可能輕鬆地建立更優質且更安全的體驗，包括遊戲，並最終觸及更多用戶。我們持續投資於為創作者建立工具，以促進關鍵體驗類型並深化平台上的參與度。
Roblox 的成長主要由對科技的重大投資以及兩個相互強化網路效應：內容與連結所驅動。
首先，由我們創作者社羣所建立的用戶生成內容支撐我們的平台。當創作者建立越來越優質且多樣的內容時，會吸引更多的用戶加入我們的平台。隨著更多用戶加入我們的平台，將產生更高的參與度與營收機會，這使得 Roblox 對創作者更具吸引力，鼓勵他們設計更具吸引力的內容，並促使新創作者開始在平台上建立內容。
其次，我們的平台鼓勵用戶之間的連結。當用戶加入時，他們通常會與朋友互動，這會促使他們邀請更多朋友，而這些朋友又會邀請他們的朋友，從而推動自然成長。每位用戶在平台上與更多朋友互動，將使平台更具價值與吸引力。這會透過現有平台用戶的口耳相傳，吸引更多用戶加入我們的平台。
Roblox 由我們創作者社羣所建立的內容支撐，這些內容包括在 Roblox 上建立的沉浸式與吸引人的體驗，以及大多數用來自訂虛擬形象的項目。這些內容吸引我們的用戶沉浸於平台上數百萬種體驗中。許多用戶最終也可能成為創作者。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年，平均每日活躍用戶數（DAUs）達 1.27 億，遍及超過 180 個國家，在行動、桌面與主機平台上享受 Roblox 的體驗，其中平均每日獨特付費用戶數約為 180 萬。我們的用戶在多個維度上具有多樣性，包括年齡、地理、平台與性別。每天，用戶透過他們的虛擬形象表達自己，探索不同的世界，並與 Roblox 社羣中的其他人互動。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年，用戶在平台上總共投入 1239 億小時的參與時間，即每位 DAU 每天平均參與 2.7 小時。在相同期間，用戶平均每月在平台上探索超過 24 種不同的體驗。
（1）代表2025年12月31日財年期間的平均值。有關營運指標的詳細資訊，請參閱「關於營運指標的特別說明」。百分比係根據以千為單位的基礎數字計算，因四捨五入關係，可能無法與各自總計完全相加。

我們認為每個人都可以成為創作者。我們為創作者提供能力，讓他們能在Marketplace中建立吸引人且沉浸式的體驗，並在Creator Store中提供與虛擬形象相關的物品、自訂模型、插件、音訊、字型、圖片、網格和影片，使其能輕鬆與Roblox社羣分享。我們的創作者使我們能夠在平台上提供廣泛的內容，並以成本效益的方式集資提供平台上的體驗、Marketplace商品以及創作者工具生態系統。在2025年12月31日財年期間，我們在全球超過170個國家擁有數百萬創作者正在使用我們的平台進行創作。我們的創作者社羣包含具備廣泛專業能力與團隊規模的個人，從年輕學生和獨立愛好者，一直到全職的創意工作室。
我們根據我們的經濟體系與用戶參與度來衡量創作者社羣的健康與成功。隨著我們的平台規模擴張，我們的 monetizing 創作者已持續成長，這反映我們平台的日益受歡迎與 monetization 的機會增加，並驅動我們的創作者持續創作高品質內容的動機。
我們為創作者社羣提供多種模式，以協助他們達成目標。具體來說，創作者可以透過以下方式累積Robux（我們稱為「 earned Robux 」），或在某些情況下，直接以現金（ herein 稱為「 fiat currency 」，以區別於 Robux，其為遊戲內貨幣）進行付款：
1. 透過開發體驗進行 monetizing ：創作者可以透過以下方式累積 earned Robux ：
a. 在體驗內的購買，包含由體驗內虛擬物品銷售產生的微交易、訂閱型服務（包括私人伺服器存取權）、特定體驗的存取權（稱為付費存取），以及/或提供特殊體驗內權限的通行證。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況、營運結果及現金流的討論與分析，應與本檔所附之合併財務報表及其相關附註，並於本檔第 8 項「合併財務報表與補充資料」中說明。本檔之討論與分析及其他部分之年度報告表 10-K，包含前瞻性陳述，例如與我們計畫、目標、預期、意圖及信念相關之陳述，這些陳述涉及風險、不確定性及假設。我們實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述有重大差異，原因可能包括本檔年度報告表 10-K 其他部分所討論之因素，例如「風險因素」、「前瞻性陳述特別說明」及「營運指標特別說明」等部分。我們歷史結果未必能代表未來任何期間之結果。除非上下文另有明確要求，本報告中所有提及「Roblox」、「公司」、「我們」、「我們的」、「我們」或類似詞彙，均指 Roblox Corporation 及其子公司。

本檔年度報告表 10-K 之本節討論我們財務狀況於 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度及 2024 年 12 月 31 日財務年度之結果，以及 2025 財務年度與 2024 財務年度之年對年比較。本檔年度報告表 10-K 未包含之 2023 財務年度財務狀況及 2024 財務年度與 2023 財務年度之年對年比較討論，可於我們 2024 年 12 月 31 日財務年度之年度報告表 10-K 中「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」部分找到。

來自世界各地的人們每天都來到 Roblox 連線。他們一起創造、遊玩、工作、學習，並在由我們全球創作者社羣所建構的體驗中與彼此連線。我們的平台由用戶生成的內容驅動，並從遊戲、娛樂、社交媒體，甚至玩具中汲取靈感。

我們的沉浸式遊戲與創作平台包含 Roblox 客戶端、Roblox 工具組及 Roblox 雲端（合稱為「Roblox 平台」或「平台」）。Roblox 客戶端是免費應用程式，讓用戶可以探索沉浸式體驗。Roblox 工具組是免費工具組，讓創作者可以建構、發佈及運作沉浸式體驗及其他內容，這些內容可透過 Roblox 客戶端存取。Roblox 雲端包含支撐我們平台的服務與基礎設施。我們持續透過投資高忠實度虛擬形象、更真實的體驗、人工智慧（「AI」）工具及其他連線功能來創新我們的平台。

我們的使命是用樂觀與文明的方式，將十億用戶連線。我們持續改善平台支持共創體驗的方式，從這些體驗由積極參與的創作者社羣所建構，到全球用戶如何享受並安全存取這些體驗。我們也相信，在 Roblox 生態系統中，有強大的潛力可以佔據更大的全球遊戲市場份額。我們的目標是讓創作者盡可能輕鬆地建構更優質且更安全的體驗，包括遊戲，並最終觸及更多用戶。我們持續投資於為創作者打造工具，以促進關鍵體驗類型，並加深在平台上的參與度。

根據我們免費使用之商業模式，我們的用戶中僅有小部分為付費用戶。例如，在 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度，我們 1.27 億平均每日活躍用戶（「DAUs」）中，僅約 180 萬為平均每日獨特付費用戶。同樣地，在 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度，我們的平均每日每 DAU 預訂金額為 0.15 美元，而平均每日每獨特付費用戶預訂金額為 10.36 美元。我們相信維持並增加我們總用戶數，包括可能不購買與花費 Robux 的用戶數，對我們業務的成功至關重要。因此，我們相信選擇購買與花費 Robux 的用戶數將持續佔我們總用戶數中的一小部分。

我們持續創新我們的安全工具，並推出新 safeguards 以促進用戶在平台上的安全與愉快體驗。隨著我們的安全團隊持續創新並利用科技進展，以協助用戶在平台上感到安全，我們預期會持續實施平台政策、產品、科技及其他變更，包括預見及回應美國與國際上專注於兒童與網路安全之主要全球組織的規範與指導方針。我們目前正在開發、測試並實施年齡確認系統，用以在用戶存取平台聊天功能前確認其年齡。我們的安全變更已影響並可能在未來繼續影響參與度、留存率、收入與預訂金額。
本公司主要的投資領域為創作者社羣，以及維持改善 Roblox 平台、同時維護並建立安全且文明的線上社羣所需的人力、技術與基礎建設，包括信任與安全系統。這些投資領域是驅動業務的關鍵，與付款處理費用一同代表本公司主要的營運成本。
本公司認為績效受到許多因素影響，包括下列關鍵指標，這些指標為本公司追蹤與審閱以衡量績效、識別趨勢、制定財務預測及做出戰略決策所使用。
本公司透過追蹤多項營運指標來管理業務，包括下列所列的指標。作為管理團隊，我們認為這些營運指標對投資者及其他人士提供有用的資訊。如需完整定義與這些指標的限制，請參閱本年度報告 10-K 表單中標題為「特別說明營運指標」的章節。
本公司將每日活躍用戶（DAU）定義為在特定日曆日內，透過網站或應用程式登入並造訪 Roblox 的用戶，使用獨特註冊帳號。若註冊且已登入的用戶在24小時內跨越兩個日曆日造訪 Roblox 超過一次，該用戶僅計入第一個日曆日的 DAU。本公司將 DAU 作為衡量平台上參與用戶規模的指標。我們認為 DAU 的長期增長反映平台價值的持續提升。

本公司將「使用時長」定義為用戶在平台上花費的時間。我們計算總使用時長為特定期間內用戶會話長度的總和。我們使用內部系統追蹤用戶在平台上的活動作為離散事件，並將這些離散活動合併為用戶會話。用戶在平台上的會話可能包含，例如在體驗中、Roblox Studio 中、平台功能如聊天與頭像客製化、創作者商店中所花費的時間，以及因追蹤系統限制與估計方法所導致的部分非活動時間。我們認為使用時長的長期增長反映平台價值的持續提升。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
本公司有淨虧損的歷史，未來可能無法實現或維持盈利。
本公司曾經歷快速成長，部分原因在於某些體驗在平台上的病毒式傳播，而我們的成長速度可能無法反映未來成長或市場的成長。
本公司面臨許多法律程序，這些程序耗費時間且成本高昂，可能損害我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果。
若本公司無法留住用戶或增加新用戶，或若用戶減少與平台互動的程度，將會對我們的營收、訂單及營運成果造成損害。
本公司依賴創作者創作用戶認為有吸引力的數位內容，若本公司未能適當激勵創作者開發及商業化內容，將會對我們的業務造成損害。
若本公司無法進一步商業化平台及用戶羣，將會對我們的業務造成損害。

paragraphs: 有關我們業務之風險與不確定性之說明如下。請您謹慎考量下列所列之風險，以及本年度報告表10-K中之其他資訊，包括我們之合併財務報表及「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」。上述任何事件或發展之發生，可能會對我們之業務、財務狀況、營運成果與成長前景造成重大且不利之影響。若發生此類事件，本公司A類普通股之市場價格可能會下跌，您可能喪失全部或部分投資。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為我們所知或我們目前認為不具重大性，也可能影響我們之業務、財務狀況、營運成果與成長前景。
以下為使投資本公司A類普通股成為投機性或風險性投資之主要因素之總結：
•本公司有淨虧損之歷史，未來可能無法實現或維持盈利。
•本公司之業務受季節性需求影響，財務狀況與營運成果將會按季別波動，使財務結果難以預測，且可能無法完全反映本公司之實際表現。
•本公司受全球各國法律與法規之影響，而這些法律與法規持續在變動，可能會增加本公司之成本或對本公司業務造成不利影響，包括可能阻止本公司在某些司法管轄區運作其平台。
•本公司曾於某些時期經歷快速成長，部分原因在於其平台某些體驗之病毒式傳播，而本公司之成長率可能無法反映未來成長或市場之成長。
